feeds.what: every contest of the election in one document (statewide totals, 145 contests), the Enhanced Voting data endpoint the page itself reads
feeds.notes: Standard Enhanced Voting shape: …/results/public/api/elections/<slug>/<publicElectionId>/data with slug 'id' and publicElectionId 'nov2026'. Top-level keys: jurisdiction, election, localityElections (44 counties), ballotItems (145), precincts, pollingPlaces, statistics, voterRegistration, voterTurnout, ballotItemWithBreakdown. 523,187 bytes uncompressed (34,144 gzip). Cache-Control: public, max-age=60. No CORS header on this endpoint (and cross-origin-resource-policy: same-origin).

feeds.what: the media export: every contest with county and precinct breakdowns, one file
feeds.saved_as: export-nov2026.first1MB.json (first 1 MB) and export-nov2026.sample.json (six contests cut out verbatim: US Senator, Governor, US Representative District 1, State Senator District 1, State Representative District 1 Seat A, HJR 4)
feeds.notes: 8,233,693 bytes, served as application/octet-stream with access-control-allow-origin: * and a real Last-Modified. The path comes from data.json: jurisdiction.mediaExportPath = 'id/export-nov2026.json', appended to https://results.voteidaho.gov/cdn/results/. Shape: {electionDate, electionName, createdAt, results:{id,name,ballotItems[145],reportingStatuses}, localResults[]}. Simpler than /data: contest 'name' and option 'name' are plain strings, 'politicalParty' is a plain string, contests have short ids ('ussen', 'usrep1'). The statewide part is in the first ~100 KB, but the file has to be downloaded whole.

feeds.what: the list of elections for the state (and the 44 county sub-sites)
feeds.notes: elections[] has publicElectionId, electionDate, name. On 2026-11-10: nov2026, may2026, dec2025, nov2025.

election_id: 'nov2026' (the site's publicElectionId), with jurisdiction slug 'id'. It appears in the page URL (/results/public/id/elections/nov2026), the data URL (/api/elections/id/nov2026/data) and the export name (export-nov2026.json).
discovery: GET https://results.voteidaho.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/id and read elections[] (publicElectionId + electionDate); pick the entry for the date. Note that the path OpenSlate may expect, …/results/public/api/elections/id (elections list), answers 404 here; the list is under /api/jurisdictions/<slug>.
cors: none on /results/public/api/… (data and jurisdictions); '*' on the media export at /cdn/results/id/export-nov2026.json
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 200 on everything (Cloudflare in front of Azure Front Door, no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried. One trap on this machine only: Git Bash's curl 8.8.0 (Schannel) fails on this host with 'curl: (43) A libcurl function was given a bad argument' during TLS renegotiation; Windows' own curl 8.22 and headless Chrome work.
updated_field: data.json: election.asOf = '2026-11-09T18:48:10.2302686Z' (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z); also election.lastUpdated '2026-11-09T18:31:57.4205767Z' and publishDate. Each contest repeats it at ballotItems[].reportingStatus.asOf. Export: createdAt = '2026-11-09T18:48:12.1268162Z'. election.isOfficialResults = false.
reporting_field: Per contest: ballotItems[].reportingStatus.reportingUnits / totalUnits, where the units are counties (US Senator 44/44, US Representative District 1 19/19, State Senator District 1 2/2). Per county: localityElections[].precinctReportingStatus[] with groupName 'Fully Reported' / 'Partially Reported' / … and a precinct count in 'value' (Ada County: Fully Reported 197), plus jurisdiction.childLocalities[].percentReporting (1.0). In the export, precinctsParticipating and precinctsReporting are null at state level.

measures: Idaho Constitutional Amendment: House Joint Resolution 4

choice_format: data.json: name is a language list and party an object, e.g. {"nativeId":"JimRisch-1-Republican","name":[{"languageId":"en","text":"Jim Risch"}],"voteCount":401751,"party":{"name":[{"languageId":"en","text":"Republican"}],"abbreviation":"REP"}}. Export: {"id":"JimRisch-1-Republican","name":"Jim Risch","voteCount":401751,"politicalParty":"Republican"}. Measures have contestType 'BallotMeasure' and options named 'YES' and 'NO' (nativeId 'InFavor-1-' and 'Against-2-'; in data.json their 'party' object is named 'Yes' / 'No'); the question text is in 'referendum' as HTML and 'voteFor' holds the threshold ('Requires 50% + 1 vote to pass').
district_field: Only in the title ('State Senator District 1', 'State Representative District 1 Seat A': Idaho house districts have two seats, A and B, each its own contest). No separate district field. The export's short contest id encodes it for Congress ('usrep1'). contestGroupId maps to election.contestGroups[] headings: Federal, Statewide, State Legislature, State Measures, Judicial, Local Districts, Local Measures.
